item.title: Miss Minden Contestant Jillian Duggan

item.title: Miss Minden Contestant Jazzie Jackson
item.description: Jazzie Jackson is competing in Saturday’s annual Miss Minden Pageant at Minden High School Auditorium. Jazzie was born in Shreveport, raised in Dallas and “found her way” back to her roots in Louisiana. She is a second-year law student at LSU Law Center.
